description:
Get heartbeat score for a registration

A registered token's health on one chain: its heartbeat score (0-100), the status derived from it, and the three parts it is built from (recent on-chain activity, DEX volume, holder health). A registration whose heartbeat stays low can lapse and become claimable again, so the score tells a live token page from a dormant one. Answers 404 for a symbol that has no registration on that chain.

chain.description: Chain key (e.g. `arbitrum`, `base`). EVM chains only; a Solana chain answers 400.

tokenAddress.description: The token's contract address, when several tokens on the chain share the ticker.

name: check_heartbeat

confidence.description: Staleness annotation (0-100). 100 when underlying market data is < 1h old, 0 when ≥ 12h, linear in between. NOT part of the on-chain leaf hash.

holders.description: Holder Health Score (0-100, weight 20%) — composite of concentration, suspicious-wallet ratio, distribution, and scale

volume.description: Volume score (0-100, weight 30%) — DEX volume blended across 24h + 7d (default 70/30) and capped at 100× pool liquidity, then log-scaled into [$20, $100k]

score.description: Composite heartbeat score (0-100). Weighted sum of timestamp + volume + holder-health.

status.description: Heartbeat status derived from the score: `grace_period`, `healthy`, `moderate`, `at_risk` or `inactive`

title: Check a token's heartbeat
